Pelunasan Pajak di Tahun Berjalan Setelah diperoleh angka Penghasilan Kena Pajak dan pajak terutang, langkah berikutnya adalah mengurangkan pajak penghasilan hasil perhitungan dengan kredit pajak. Kredit pajak adalah pajak yang sebelumnya sudah dibayar, baik melalui mekanisme pemotongan oleh pihak lain, ataupun penyetoran sendiri. Hasil dari pengurangan tersebut adalah pajak penghasilan yang masih harus dibayar sendiri. Ilustrasi Penghitungan Pajak Terutang Setelah mengetahui konsep di atas, mari kita lihat ilustrasi berikut. Bapak Leopold, seorang pekerja kantoran dengan usaha sambilan reparasi alat elektronik memiliki satu orang istri dan satu orang anak yang sudah berusia dua tahun. Ia memiliki total penghasila

temporal.amendmentAssessment: PP20/2026 changes PP55/2022; retained exact old/new article scope and ArticleII transitions. Coverage end is a review boundary, not claimed repeal.
temporal.basis: PP20/2026 amended Art56-58, removed Art59; unchanged Art60-61 read with PP55. Whole requested month must fit after commencement.

exclusions: Prior-year turnover must include the legally relevant branches/spouse/business group; 2026 also professional and foreign turnover and all relevant one-founder companies. Human review of aggregation required.
Income category must be reviewed against Article56 exclusions: professional work, foreign-taxed income, separately final-taxed and exempt income are excluded.
2026 Jan-Apr split/transition, cooperatives, other legal forms, legacy beneficiaries and permanently disqualified histories need separate review.
Only one complete tax month; YTD before this month includes all relevant business outlets. No monthly-to-annual duplicate aggregation.
Exact whole-rupiah subset: taxable monthly gross must be a multiple of IDR200; other amounts unresolved pending governed rounding evidence.

provenance.quote: Sole trader A sole trader is an individual running a business. It is the simplest and cheapest way to run a business. If you run your business as a sole trader, you are: the sole owner and controller of it legally responsible for all aspects of the business, including debts and losses you incur in running it. You can employ workers in your business, but you can't employ yourself. As a sole trader, you are responsible for paying your worker’s superannuation , known as super guarantee. You don't have to pay super guarantee for yourself but you can choose to make personal super contributions to save for your retirement.
